work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLII extends to the Daughters of Charity throughout France the monthly plenary indulgence granted by Leo XII to those of the Paris diocese; LF32801 → LF32806 across running title LF32803; complete 10 August 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF32758–32758; the source closing at LF32806–32809 reads: Datum Romae- apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
